detail.longDescription: I'm planning to build an Agentic HR platform - an AI agent-powered system for HR management. I want to understand what core features and capabilities this kind of platform should have. Background: I'm a full-stack developer working on HR tech projects I want to use AI agents (LLM-based) to automate HR workflows Target users: HR teams, recruiters, and employees What I want to know: 1. Core HR Features: What are the essential HR management features that should be included? (e.g., recruitment, onboarding, performance reviews, etc.) 2. AI Agent Capabilities: What tasks should the AI agents handle? For example: Resume screening and candidate matching Answering employee questions (HR chatbot) Scheduling interviews automatically Generating job descriptions Onboarding new employees Performance feedback analysis or any thing else your idea could think of 3. Technical Architecture: Should I use single agent or multi-agent system? How to handle sensitive employee data securely? What databases work best for HR data? How to integrate with existing HRIS systems? 4. User Experience: What interfaces do HR teams and employees need? How to make AI decisions transparent and explainable? How to handle edge cases when AI makes mistakes? My current tech stack: Backend: Node.js / Elysia / Bun Database: PostgreSQL AI: LLM APIs (planning to use LangChain or similar) Deployment: VPS Any advice, best practices, or lessons learned from building similar systems would be very helpful!
